### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the enhancement

To improve the output of `show reboot-cause` and `show reboot-cause history` for debugging.

And to introduce Nexthop's CLI -- `nh_reboot_cause` which prints out a series of reboot causes (from both SW and HW) and the blackbox records, to further aids the debugging of reboot causes.

### Current Behavior

Current `show reboot-cause [history]` cannot handle complex scenarios, e.g. multiple reboots / multiple causes from multiple DPMs.

Current `nh_reboot_cause` CLI just print out the blackbox dump without any interpretation.

Both did not show UTC timestamp.

### Proposed Behavior

- Both CLIs should show the event time as UTC timestamp when possible.
- `show reboot-cause [history]` to be able to handle complex reboot scenarios. For example:
```
$ show reboot-cause history
Name                 Cause                                                                                                            Time                             User    Comment
-------------------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  -------------------------------  ------  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2025_11_21_01_21_29  Power Loss (Software commanded power cycle, time: 2025-11-21 <IPV6> UTC, src: switch_card)                     N/A                              N/A     System rebooted 3 more times: Power Loss (Software commanded power cycle, time: 2025-11-21 <IPV6> UTC, src: switch_card); Power Loss (Software commanded power cycle, time: 2025-11-21 <IPV6> UTC, src: switch_card); Power Loss (Both PSUs lost input power, time: 37.605026s after power-on, src: switch_card)
2025_11_21_01_09_35  Kernel Panic                                                                                                     Fri Nov 21 <IPV6> AM UTC 2025  N/A     N/A
2025_11_21_01_05_29  reboot                                                                                                           Fri Nov 21 <IPV6> AM UTC 2025  admin   N/A
2025_11_21_01_02_56  Thermal Overload: Other (Switch card exceeded overtemperature, time: 2025-11-21 <IPV6> UTC, src: switch_card)  N/A                              N/A     System rebooted 1 more time: Power Loss (Both PSUs lost input power, time: 45.039200s after power-on, src: switch_card)
```

- `nh_reboot_cause` to give descriptive view of DPM logs from previous reboots. For example:
```
$ sudo nh_reboot_cause history -v
=== Captured at 2025-11-22 <IPV6> UTC ===
[2025-11-22 <IPV6> UTC] cause: Kernel Panic; description: n/a; source: SW
 DPM records:
  switch_card:powerup_2323:uid_29833       timestamp: 2025-11-22 <IPV6> UTC
```

resolution.title: [Nexthop] Improve ADM1266 reboot-cause support
resolution.description: #### Why I did it Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/25167 - Please ignore commits like `IGNORE THIS COMMIT: Refactor unit tests for sonic-platform-modules-nexthop (PR #25166)` - To enhance the reboot-cause support on NH-5010 and extend the support to NH-4010 and NH-4220. - To make the code more structured and generalized. - This PR handles complex scenarios, e.g. when units reboots multiple times, when multiple DPMs report faults, when both SW and HW present reboot causes, and etc. It will be helpful for debugging the units that experience unexpected reboots and/or power rail failures. ##### Work item tracking - Microsoft ADO **(number only)**: #### How I did it High-level overview: - Introduced `RebootCauseManager` to process the reboot causes from both SW and HW, and return the information as `list[RebootCause]` back the `Chassis`. - Introduced `DpmBase` and `DpmRecord` which are base classes with abstracted methods to be implemented by child classes, such as `Adm1266` and `Adm1266BlackBoxRecord` respectively. Each `DpmBase` should have functionality to retrieve and clear the records from the underlying HW. - Rename `SystemDPMLogHistory` to `DpmLogger`, which will be used by `RebootCauseManager` to log the reboot causes and raw records, and by `nh_reboot_cause` CLI to display the logged information. - Introduced the "power-up" concept, where we analyze a group of records as a `DpmPowerUpEntry`. This makes it easier for `RebootCauseManager` to analyze the cause per reboot among many DPMs. Some more changes: - Write real time onto the ADM1266 based on a custom epoch (2024-01-01), so the fault event will be recorded with the UTC timestamp. - Fix bug in how `adm1266.c` read blackbox from the ADM1266. The max records should be 32 instead. - At `show techsupport`: includes the output of `nh_reboot_cause history -vv` and `nh_reboot_cause read-blackbox` #### How to verify it Tried multiple scenarios of reboot on NH-5010 DUT and got the following output: ``` admin@sonic:~$ show reboot-cause history Name Cause Time User Comment ------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------- ------ ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 2026_01_28_18_41_57 reboot Wed Jan 28 PM UTC 2026 admin N/A 2026_01_28_18_32_03 Kernel Panic (time: 2026-01-28 UTC, src: SW) N/A N/A System rebooted 1 more time: Power Loss (Both PSUs lost input power, time: 2026-01-28 UTC, src: switch_card_1) 2026_01_28_18_24_18 Thermal Overload: Other (Switch card exceeded overtemperature, time: 2026-01-28 UTC, src: switch_card_1) N/A N/A Unknown 2026_01_28_18_20_06 Watchdog (FPGA watchdog expired, time: 2026-01-28 UTC, src: switch_card_1) N/A N/A Unknown 2026_01_28_18_02_57 reboot Wed Jan 28 PM UTC 2026 admin N/A ``` ``` admin@sonic:~$ sudo nh_reboot_cause history === Captured at 2026-01-28 UTC === [2026-01-28 UTC] cause: FPGA_PWR_CYC_REQ;
